title: eludite.forge.auth input
description: Sign in to a forge host, sign out, or read who is signed in (Git > Sign in to <forge>). `status` lists the hosts with a stored token and the workspace's. `sign_in` stores the token in the operating system's credential store (Secret Service, Keychain, Credential Manager), or, only when that is unavailable and `allow_file_store` says the person agreed, in a file only they can read (mode 0600) under Eludite's config directory: `method` `token` takes a personal access token in `token` (checked against the forge before it is stored), `device` starts the OAuth device flow and answers its `device.user_code` and `device.verification_uri` at once (the flow completes off-thread; read `status` until `signed_in`), `app_password` (Tangled) takes the handle in `user` and an app password in `token` for an atproto session, `cli` reads the token `gh auth token` or `glab auth token` prints (the only process the forge integration starts). `sign_out` removes the host's token. The token is never written to a log, an audit entry, the cache or any output.
x-eludite-escalates: Refused for agents (`sign_in`, `sign_out`, `cancel`): an agent never signs in; `status` is a read.

action.description: `cancel` stops a device flow in progress.

host.description: The forge host (default the workspace remote's).

token.description: The personal access token or app password (`token`, `app_password`). Never echoed.

user.description: Tangled: the handle or DID (`app_password`); Azure DevOps Server: the user name a token goes with.

allow_file_store.description: The person agreed to keep the token in a 0600 file when the credential store is unavailable.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
